FAQs

How do I know which page to use?

Choose the page that matches your starting area (Harbor Country, Indiana visitor, or I-94/US-12 travel route) for the fastest, most relevant directions and FAQs.

Do I need an ID?

Yes. A valid government-issued ID is required. 21+ only.

Do you accept out-of-state IDs?

In most cases, valid government IDs from other states are accepted—bring your ID to confirm eligibility.

Can I view the menu before I arrive?

Yes. You can view our full menu online before your visit to browse products, pricing, and availability.

Do you have parking?

Yes, convenient on-site parking is available for customers.

What are your busiest times?

Weekends and late afternoons are typically the busiest. Visiting earlier in the day often means shorter wait times.

Can staff help first-time visitors choose?

Absolutely. Our team is happy to guide first-time visitors and help you find products that match your preferences and comfort level.

What’s the quickest way to shop if I’m traveling?

Bring ID, choose a category + budget, and tell staff you want a quick trip—we’ll help you move fast.
